purpose: Prove whether skill-quality-audit improves real Skill review output before promoting from conditional-team-use to team-ready.

cases.prompt: Audit shared/skills/overview for team-use readiness. Produce a formal JSON report, Markdown summary, current evidence, repair handoff, and validator result. Do not edit the target Skill.

Audit shared/skills/research for team-use readiness and stale/invalid audit artifact risk. Produce a formal JSON report, Markdown summary, current evidence, repair handoff, and validator result. Do not edit the target Skill.

recording_requirements: Each run must include a non-empty raw_output_ref file preserving the produced audit output.
Each with_skill output must include a validator-passing formal report or a blocked verdict with validator-passing JSON, and formal_report_ref must target the reviewed Skill.
Each without_skill output must be graded against the same anchors and readiness checks.
Human delta review must compare whether with_skill improves evidence integrity, handoff usability, and structure-content judgment.
Update lifecycle-review.json only after summaries and delta review exist.
